title: Calendar write safety
blurb: Known authorization failures offer Reauthorize calendar; ordinary refresh reuses valid grants. Retrying unchanged creation in the same editor reuses its Google event ID or Microsoft transaction ID. Check the provider before changing an uncertain submission and starting another event. Plain-text descriptions preserve literal angle brackets; readable HTML descriptions retain link targets. Outlook description edits tolerate surrounding whitespace in an unchanged baseline and still require the provider revision to match. Non-time edits omit time fields, preserving offsets and seconds through repeated daylight-saving hours. Ambiguous or nonexistent local time edits require another time or the provider editor with an explicit offset. Confirmed saves and deletes invalidate all cached months for the changed mailbox, even after closing the editor. Google and Outlook calendar enumeration each follow up to five pages; an incomplete list leaves saved selections unchanged. Saved calendar checks are stored and restored in full. Timed agenda and day-cell rows sort by actual instants across UTC offsets.
